methodologyNotes: Roster covers 11 high-search electric space heater models spanning ceramic, infrared, oil-filled, and fan/vortex types; Govee Smart Heater models H7130-H7135 were excluded due to a prior CPSC recall (fire/burn hazard). Specs were re-verified primarily against official manufacturer product pages (dreo.com, lasko.com, vornado.com, heatstorm.com, drheaterusa.com, honeywellstore.com) with corroboration from major retailers (Amazon, Home Depot, Walmart, Lowe's, Best Buy, Ace Hardware) and independent reviews. Booleans indicate verified presence (true) or confirmed absence (false); null indicates no verifiable data found. Wattage figures are maximum rated watts; coverage figures are manufacturer-stated or retailer-confirmed square footage; priceUsd is the published US MSRP or typical buy-it-now price found on a manufacturer or major retailer page at time of research, set to null where no reliable live published price exists (e.g. discontinued models). accessedAt 2026-06-19. Corrections applied vs draft: Dreo Atom One heat_settings 4->5; De'Longhi EW7707CM tip_over_protection null->true; Honeywell HCE200W priceUsd 42.99->null (discontinued); Dr Infrared DR-988 priceUsd 139.99->129.99 (manufacturer page).

products.name: Dreo Solaris Slim H3 (ALCI)
products.provenance: Re-verified on official Dreo product page: 700-1500W range, 5 modes (H1/H2/H3/ECO/Fan), 41-95°F adjustable thermostat in 1°F increments, 70° oscillation, ALCI plug with tip-over and overheat protection. Price $84.99 confirmed live on dreo.com. Coverage ~200 sqft per product positioning and independent review. No official release date stated (null).

products.provenance: Re-verified on official Dreo page: 900-1500W, FIVE modes (High/Medium/Low/ECO/Fan) - draft's heat_settings of 4 corrected to 5. 41-95°F adjustable thermostat, 70° oscillation, tip-over protection, 12h timer. Coverage ~200 sqft per multiple review sources. Price $49.99 confirmed on dreo.com. Release year 2022 inferred from Amazon ASIN B0B3MXGBVT (B0B-era listing) rather than an official launch announcement.

products.provenance: Verified 2026-07-10 by re-fetching both URLs. Manufacturer source (dreo.com official blog "Introducing DREO OH521 Radiator Heater," dated Mar 18, 2024) confirms Dreo's OH521 oil-filled radiator with power settings of 600W, 900W and 1500W plus an ECO mode, tip-over protection, flame-retardant material, overheat protection, a safety plug, a 24-hour timer and remote control. The Amazon retailer page (corroboration) explicitly lists Model Number / Part Number DR-HSH011 (ASIN B0CQ2918KX), and its product-information table gives Heat Output 1500 Watts, Heating Coverage 250 sq.ft., Number of Speeds 4 with Mode Options H1/H2/H3/ECO, an adjustable thermostat 41-95°F in 1°F increments, and Tip-Over + Overheat Protection on an 8-fin oil-filled radiant floor-mount unit; the same page's product description ("DREO Large Heater Oil-filled Radiator 521" / "radiator heater oh521") and its Large-Heater-Family table (OH521 = 8 fins) tie DR-HSH011 to the OH521 series, so model identity is confirmed (no sibling/capacity mismatch). All non-null spec values were found verbatim in the fetched text: type=oil_filled (title "Oil Filled Radiator Heater"), max_wattage_w=1500 ("Heat Output 1500 Watts"), coverage_sqft=250 ("Heating Coverage 250 sp.ft."), heat_settings=4 ("Number of Speeds 4"; four modes H1/H2/H3/ECO), thermostat=true ("Digital Thermostat", 41-95°F adjustable), tip_over_protection=true ("built with tip-over protection"). oscillation is set false: this is a static oil-filled radiator with no oscillation mechanism, and the "Oscillation" table row's "360° Three-dimensional Heating" refers to radiant heat dissipation rather than mechanical oscillation (a review confirms "since there is no fan, the heat is strictly radiant"), matching the De'Longhi oil_filled precedent in this catalog. release is null due to a genuine conflict between Amazon's "Manufacture Year 2020" field and Dreo's own blog describing the OH521 as "brand-new" in March 2024. priceUsd is null because no reliable live US price could be fetched: the Amazon page showed "No featured offers available" with all on-page prices in EUR (Germany delivery), Home Depot and Lowe's returned 403, and the only figure, $129.99, was on a Dreo staging store marked Sold out.
